name: a11y-skills-toolkit
description: Agent skills for frontend accessibility: audit real routes against WCAG 2.2 AA, fix issues in the existing stack, re-scan to prove the fix, and add a Playwright + axe regression test.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, fix and regression-test web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
interface.longDescription: Three skills: a11y-auditor (read-only audit of real routes with Playwright + axe-core and manual checks), a11y-implementer (accessible fixes in React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML, verified by re-scanning), and a11y-reference (WCAG 2.2 AA checklist, ARIA patterns, report format, scanner and test template).
defaultPrompt: Audit the main routes of this app for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility issues
